metadata.title: 80s Rock Portrait with Dramatic Shadow Play

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a central subject against a backdrop of diagonal, soft-edged shadow bands, topped with bold red sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a person with textured hair wearing a trench coat, rendered in grainy black and white. The background is defined by strong, diagonal light and shadow beams. A large, bold red title spans the top edge, with a smaller subtitle centered beneath it.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red typography contrasts against a grayscale photographic base
Diagonal shadow bands create a rhythmic background pattern
The subject's profile gaze directs attention toward the left edge
Grainy texture unifies the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Diagonal shadow beams in the background
Primary title in vibrant red at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red title, move down to the subject's face, and follow the diagonal shadows across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The areas between the shadow beams provide textured negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the background; high saturation contrast in the title.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to grayscale and one primary accent color (red).

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a prominent horizontal bar

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top of the background
Floating in the upper background space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monotype family pairing using weight and tracking contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric uppercase structure and sharp corners.
Provides the tight, overlapping-capable geometric feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy black and white portrait of a person in a trench coat, centered, with a background of soft-edged diagonal light and shadow beams.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red geometric sans-serif title at the top. Below it, add a small black subtitle with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the main title vibrant red?
Is the photography monochrome and grainy?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the title
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Consistent film grain across the image

postGenerationChecks: Red color is saturated and stands out from the grayscale
Shadow beams are distinct but have soft edges
Grain texture is visible in both light and dark areas
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Diagonal Shadow Beams + Bold Red Geometric Header
